scope: New provider-demo driver and provider-integration evidence only

injectedCliFailure.method: Invoked through a Bun wrapper that captured output and compared temp-directory listings and success evidence before/after

interruptedCompilation.method: Bun wrapper waited for the isolated CRE compiler JS artifact with a bounded 15-second readiness loop, then sent SIGTERM to the driver

limitations: Synthetic policy, observations and agreement snapshot; not live venue or chain state
Actual position service and actual CRE HTTP capability; not a hardware TEE
Loopback chain-ID metadata stub supports only the mandatory CLI startup check
No broadcast, deployment, remote RPC, remote Git write or commit performed
These additional cleanup checks were run during implementation, not automatically by every driver invocation
